Artifact written and validated. Summary:

**Artifact** — `research/frontier-37-owner-30-alpha-groups.json` (sole write; nothing else touched).

**Partition** (10 groups × 3 batches, all 30 covered once; item totals from `--facts`):

| label | batches | items | content |
|---|---|---|---|
| a | 2+3+4 | 87 | number theory (forced whole) |
| b | 20+21+22 | 45 | braid groups (forced whole) |
| c | 8+11+12 | 87 | scheme 8 (Serre duality) + Fourier pair |
| d | 13+18+19 | 86 | diff-geometry 13 (63) + homological pair |
| e | 9+10+29 | 68 | PDE pair + complex 29 (edge 29→10 internal) |
| f | 1+14+16 | 79 | probability + rep pair |
| g | 5+15+23 | 82 | scheme 5 + rep pair |
| h | 6+17+25 | 83 | scheme 6 + computability + complex 25 |
| i | 7+26+27 | 83 | scheme 7 + Nevanlinna + elliptic functions |
| j | 24+28+30 | 78 | three complex-analysis batches |

**Validation** — `node tools/alpha-groups.mjs --run frontier-37-owner-30` → exit 0, 0 errors, 7 `mixed-category` warnings (informational), 102 dependency edges crossing group boundaries.

**Why this partition** — Max and spread are structurally pinned: number theory (87) must be one group and braid groups (45) must be one group, so no partition can beat max 87 / spread 42. Scheme theory's four batches can never share a group below the ceiling (cheapest pair 44+46 = 90), so all 102 scheme-internal edges necessarily cross; they do not depend on the residual choice. Among the ceiling-legal completions, I enumerated the 5 remaining triples exhaustively (12,810 pruned cases) and picked the minimum-deviation solution (free-group totals 68, 78, 79, 82, 83, 83, 86, 87), which also keeps the only cross-category declared edge 29→10 internal and minimises category splitting (complex analysis in 4 groups, rep theory in 2 — both provably minimal here). Excluded alternatives and their costs are stated in each rationale.

**Reported limit (not a blocker)** — the dispatch text says "at most nine groups", but 30 batches at ≤3 per group require exactly ten (`tools/autopilot/src/capacity.mjs` sets `MAX_GROUPS = ceil(30/3) = 10`, and the validator rejects only >10). Nine groups could cover at most 27 batches, so I used the ten-group width; likewise the 45-vs-87 spread is an indivisible-category limit that Step 2 authoring cannot rebalance, and it is recorded explicitly in the rationales. No permissions were requested and no scope beyond the named artifact was touched.
